en.content: A solution of 0.1 M weak base (B) is titrated with 0.1 M of a strong acid (HA). The variation of pH of the solution with the volume of HA added is shown in the figure below. What is the pKb of the base? The neutralisation reaction is given by
en.explanation:
From the given diagram, 63 mL volume of HA used till equivalence point. At half of equivalence point, solution will be basic buffer with B and BH+.



At half equivalence point :

[BH+] = [B] ( pH = 11)

Therefore, pOH = pKb = 14 11 = 3

pKb = 3.00

The figure below is the plot of potential energy versus internuclear distance (d) of H2 molecule in the electronic ground state. What is the value of the net potential energy E0 (as indicated in the figure) in kJ mol-1, for d = d0 at which the electron-electron repulsion and the nucleus-nucleus repulsion energies are absent? As reference, the potential energy of H atom is taken as zero when its electron and the nucleus are infinitely far apart.
Use Avogadro constant as 6.023 1023 mol-1.

Hence, potential energy will be calculated for 2 H atoms = 2 27.2 eV = 54.4 eV

en.content: Consider the reaction sequence from P to Q shown below. The overall yield of the major product Q from P is 75%. What is the amount in grams of Q obtained from 9.3 mL of P? (Use density of P = 1.00 g mL-1; Molar mass of C = 12.0, H = 1.0, O = 16.0 and N = 14.0 g mol-1)
en.explanation:
Aniline (P) is treated with NaNO2 and HCl in cold condition to form benzene diazonium chloride. The process of conversion of primary aromatic amines into its diazonium salt is called diazotisation.



-naphthol couples with phenyldiazonium electrophile to produce an intense orange-red dye (Q) as major product.



Given that, volume of aniline (P) = 9.3 mL (density of P = 1.00 g/mL)

So, mass of aniline = 9.3 g

Molecular mass of aniline (C6H7N) = 93 g/mol

Therefore, moles of aniline = 9.3 / 93 = 0.1 mol of P.

Molecular mass of 2 napthol aniline orange dye (Q) = 248 g/mol

0.1 mol of aniline (P) will produce 0.1 mol of compound (Q).

But, according to the question the major product Q from P is 75%.

Therefore, mass of 'Q' produced

= (0.1 248 0.75)g = 18.60 g

hi.content: नीचे दिखाए गए से अभिक्रिया क्रम पर विचार करें। से मुख्य उत्पाद की समग्र लब्धि (overall yield) है से प्राप्त उत्पाद की gram में मात्रा क्या होगी ? उपयोग करें: का घनत्व तथा के मोलर द्रव्यमान (molar mass) क्रमश: तथा हैं ]
hi.explanation:
ऐनिलीन (P) को ठंडी अवस्था में NaNO2 और HCl के साथ उपचारित करके बेंजीन डाइऐज़ोनियम क��लोराइड बनाया जाता है। प्राथमिक ऐरोमैटिक ऐमीनों को इसके डाइऐज़ोनियम लवण में परिवर्तित करने की प्रक्रिया को डाइऐज़ोटीकरण कहते हैं।



-नैफ्थॉल, फेनिलडाइऐज़ोनियम इलेक्ट्रोफाइल के साथ युग्मित होकर मुख्य उत्पाद के रूप में एक तीव्र नारंगी-लाल रंजक (Q) उत्पन्न करता है।



दिया गया है कि, ऐनिलीन (P) का आयतन = 9.3 mL (P का घनत्व = 1.00 g/mL)

अतः, ऐनिलीन का द्रव्यमान = 9.3 g

ऐनिलीन (C6H7N) का आण्विक द्रव्यमान = 93 g/mol

इसलिए, ऐनिलीन के मोल = 9.3 / 93 = 0.1 mol P का।

2 नैफ्थॉल ऐनिलीन ऑरेंज रंजक (Q) का आण्विक द्रव्यमान = 248 g/mol

0.1 mol ऐनिलीन (P) से 0.1 mol यौगिक (Q) बनेगा।

लेकिन, प्रश्न के अनुसार P से मुख्य उत्पाद Q 75% है।

इसलिए, 'Q' का उत्पादित द्रव्यमान

= (0.1 248 0.75)g = 18.60 g
